{{Short description|German mathematician}}
{{One source|date=May 2026}}
'''Carl Gottfried Franz Albert Kostka''' (3 December 1846 in [[Ełk|Lyck]] – 28 December 1921 in [[Insterburg]]) was a mathematician who introduced [[Kostka number]]s in 1882. He lived and worked in [[Insterburg]].
